look_here_first: Accepted distinct Triodanis species reported native eastern Texas. Begin with five-lobed purple corolla, alternate leaves and an inferior many-seeded capsule, but accurate species-level separation NEEDS voucher-based leaf, flower and mature capsule macros. Do not use coloradoensis/another species as a photo substitute.

morphology_keys.habit: Small annual herb of the bellflower family; plant form and flowering-stem architecture help preliminary identification.
morphology_keys.leaves: Simple alternate leaves; specialist comparison needed for exact blade dimensions and attachment.
morphology_keys.flower: Individual five-lobed usually blue-violet fused corolla at a stem leaf axil; upper open and lower closed flowers may coexist.
morphology_keys.fruit: Inferior capsule with side opening; precise window position unconfirmed in this card.
morphology_keys.stem: Alternate leafy annual stem with calyx and flower parts above an inferior ovary.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Requires flower/calyx, full stem leaf architecture and mature capsule size; purple flower alone not reliable.
